describe: make a bar chart that compares groups
guide: Group the rows by the text column and take the mean of the number column, sort it, and draw axes.bar. Label both axes, give the chart a title computed from the numbers, and save it with figure.savefig into the chart folder. Print the numbers too.
Never state a finding the code has not computed: write code that prints the result, run it, then quote what it printed.
report: There is $what now -- it is in $chart.
I drew $what and saved it to $chart.
teach: groupby puts rows with the same value together, and mean() gives one average for each group -- one bar each.
